about: Targets the scorecard (script/scorecard.sh) prints beside each user-felt number. Each comes from a plan or the owner; a metric with no number prints NO-TARGET. Change a target only with the decision that sets it.

targets.source: plan 0116: launch to a usable window in 2 s
plan 0116: every view paints in under a second
plan 0116: the first visit to All Media paints in 2 s
plan 0116: a return to a view paints in 0.3 s
plan 0116 bounds stalls over 250 ms; this count includes every stall from 100 ms, so it has no target
